note: Canonical spec keys and standard test protocols. A result produced with a protocol below, by a named third party, may be published as an L2 claim citing the protocol id.

rated_energy_wh.desc: Rated energy printed on the product; airlines use this figure

max_total_output_w.desc: Max combined output across all ports

usb_c_max_output_w.desc: Max output of the strongest single USB-C port

pb-usable-energy-20v.measures: Usable energy delivered at 20 V / 3 A until cut-off
pb-usable-energy-20v.method: Charge to 100% and rest 1 h at 25 C. Discharge through an electronic load at 20 V 3 A on the strongest USB-C port. Report delivered Wh and efficiency = delivered / rated_energy_wh.

pb-usable-energy-5v.measures: Usable energy delivered at 5 V / 2 A until cut-off
pb-usable-energy-5v.method: Same as pb-usable-energy-20v at 5 V 2 A. Phone-charging scenario.

pb-sustained-max.method: Load every port at its advertised max simultaneously for 10 min. Report the lowest 1-minute average and max surface temperature (C).

pb-recharge-time.method: Recharge with a charger able to supply max_input_w. Report minutes to 80% and to 100%.

battery_anc_on_h.desc: Manufacturer-rated playback per charge, ANC on

tws-battery-anc-75db.measures: Playback time per charge, ANC on
tws-battery-anc-75db.method: Pink-noise-calibrated music playlist at 75 dB SPL measured on an ear simulator, ANC on, default EQ, connected to a reference phone 1 m away. Run until shutdown. Report median of 3 runs.

tws-anc-attenuation.method: Ear simulator in a diffuse pink-noise field at 85 dB SPL. Report attenuation for 50-200 Hz, 200-1000 Hz and 1-4 kHz with the medium ear tips.

tws-latency.method: Click track played from a reference phone; measure output delay with a microphone. Report for each platform tested (iOS, Android).

ph-battery-web-200nits.method: Screen at 200 nits, max refresh rate, Wi-Fi on, loop a fixed set of 20 web pages every 30 s from 100% until shutdown. Report median of 2 runs.

ph-charge-0-100.method: From shutdown at 0%, charge with the fastest charger the manufacturer sells for this model. Report minutes to 50%, 80% and 100%, and the charger used.

ph-sustained-performance.method: Run a GPU stress loop for 20 min at 25 C ambient. Report lowest-loop score / best-loop score, and max back temperature (C).

ph-peak-brightness.method: Auto-brightness on, phone under strong light, measure a 100% white full-screen pattern with a colorimeter.

max_total_output_w.desc: Max combined output when one or two ports are used

all_ports_total_w.desc: Max combined output with every port in use

usb_c_max_output_w.desc: Max output of the strongest single USB-C port

dimensions_mm.desc: L x W x H, prongs excluded

chg-sustained-max.method: At 25 C ambient, load the strongest USB-C port with an electronic load at its advertised max for 30 min. Report the lowest 1-minute average and max surface temperature (C).

chg-port-split.measures: Actual power per port with every port loaded
chg-port-split.method: Connect a PD-trigger load to every port, each requesting its advertised max. Report negotiated W per port and the total after 5 minutes.

chg-efficiency.method: Measure AC input power with a calibrated meter and DC output at max_total_output_w. Report output / input.

chg-protocol-support.method: Probe each port with a USB PD / PPS / QC analyser. Report every PD fixed and PPS profile offered per port.

lt-battery-web-150nits.method: Screen at 150 nits, Wi-Fi on, default power mode, loop a fixed set of 20 web pages every 30 s from 100% until shutdown. Report median of 2 runs.

lt-sustained-cpu.measures: CPU performance stability under long load
lt-sustained-cpu.method: Run a multi-core CPU benchmark in a loop for 30 min at 25 C ambient on mains power. Report lowest-run score / first-run score.

lt-surface-temp.method: During lt-sustained-cpu, measure the keyboard deck and underside on a fixed 9-point grid with a thermal camera. Report the max.

lt-display-measured.method: Max manual brightness, SDR, 100% white full screen, measured with a colorimeter at screen centre.

weight_g.desc: Case only, largest aluminium GPS model unless stated

sw-battery-real-use.measures: Battery life in a fixed mixed-use day
sw-battery-real-use.method: Paired phone nearby, always-on display on, 100 notifications/day, 30 min GPS workout and sleep tracking per 24 h. Run from 100% until shutdown.

sw-hr-accuracy.measures: Heart-rate error against a chest strap
sw-hr-accuracy.method: 30 min interval run; compare 1 s samples with an ECG chest strap. Report mean absolute percentage error.

sw-gps-distance.measures: GPS distance error on a measured course
sw-gps-distance.method: Run a certified 5 km course 3 times without a phone. Report mean absolute distance error.

sw-charge-0-80.method: Use the charger supplied or recommended by the manufacturer. Report minutes to 80% and to 100%.
